title: Do not waste the rare chance of a human life
summary: The line gives purpose back to the day by refusing drift its usual authority. Keep this close: Let this stay with you: treat this life as rare enough to center it on Naam.
takeaway: Use this day for what can still remain.
lifeApplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as opportunity for meeting, service, or honest return.

source.shortMeaning: Human life is rare enough to demand deliberate use.
source.lifeApplication: When the day goes dull, remember how rare this chance already is.
